summary: China A-shares in stagflation with tech/semis extended, deep pullbacks elsewhere; Hong Kong risk-off under global pressure. Working thesis of A-share mean-reversion and HK riding global risk/dollar intact.
regime_read: China A-shares in Q3 (stagflation): growth -0.286 (weak), inflation 0.818 (high, moderately confident). PBoC liquidity overlay neutral but easing impulse in progress. Sector RS shows extreme bifurcation — Semiconductors (+68% 60d) and Technology (+53%) rank 1–2, while most cyclicals and defensives sit at sub-2nd percentile (Auto, Banks, Real Estate, Staples). Smallcap/largecap ratio rising (+5.3% 20d) and inflation-beta basket collapsing (-23% 20d), both contradicting the stagflation quadrant. Hong Kong also Q3 (stagflation), but with a global risk-off overlay (global score -0.692, risk-off, fear at 11), peg weak-side near 7.84, and VHSI spike. HK sector RS shows Financials/Exchanges extended (pctile 99–100), while Auto/Gaming/Materials are deeply oversold. US backdrop is Goldilocks with contracting liquidity, restrictive real yields (2.18%) and strong USD, creating headwinds for EM and HK.
conflicts: Stagflation quad vs tech/semi leadership: historically growth/tech underperforms in stagflation, not leads. The RS extremes may indicate an AI-driven disconnect.
Inflation-beta basket -23% 20d vs high inflation score (0.818): market is pricing disinflation or deflation fears, challenging the stagflation classification.
PBoC stance neutral despite multiple RRR/LPR cuts: corridor classifier hasn't flipped, so easing is priced but not confirmed — a liquidity-regime conflict.
HK Financials extended (pctile 99.6) in a Fear/Risk-off environment — typically defensive rotation would favour Utilities/Telco, not pro-cyclical financials.
US Goldilocks quad coexists with contracting liquidity and USD headwind for EM: benign US macro but restrictive transmission to China/HK via dollar strength.
rotation_check: Working thesis holds: A-shares RS leaders (semis/tech) appear extended per mean-reversion hypothesis, with deep-pullback names (auto, banks, staples) as higher-odds reversal candidates. HK diverges significantly from mainland — Internet/tech weak, while A-share tech strong — reflecting global risk-off and USD strength, exactly as the thesis predicts. Radar divergences (NEV, nonferrous metals) support the idea that beaten-down cyclicals may catch up if growth stabilises, consistent with mean-reversion and domestic policy reflation.
transmission: US real yields → USD strength → EM outflows → HK peg weak-side (7.8396) → HK equity risk premium widens, reinforcing risk-off.
PBoC corridor shift (if neutral → easing confirmed) → domestic liquidity infusion → rate-sensitives (brokers, property) re-rate → A-share breadth recovery from extremely oversold levels.
Upcoming NBS PMI (Jun 30) — if >50, cyclical-reflation chain strengthens (metals, NEV); if <50, stagflation deepens, risk-off persists and any reversion trade is delayed.
HK VHSI normalisation from fear (band 11) could trigger a sharp reversal in the most oversold HK sectors (Auto -23% 60d, Gaming -12%).
watch_items: LPR fix (Jun 22) — any cut magnitude above recent 10bp, or forward-guidance shift confirming easing stance.
NBS PMI (Jun 30) — manufacturing reading and direction; a miss would cement stagflation and extend risk-off.
CNY (6.79) break above 6.80 and HKD (7.8396) test of 7.85 weak-side convertibility undertaking — could trigger HKMA intervention/liquidity squeeze.
Semiconductor/tech momentum exhaustion — a 20-day MA break or high-volume reversal day as a trigger for mean-reversion flows into laggards.
Altdata accumulation in NEV/materials converting into positive price RS — early cyclicals confirming reflation thesis.

zh.summary: 中国A股处于滞胀状态，科技/半导体板块涨幅过大，其他板块深度回调；香港在全球压力下避险情绪升温。A股均值回归及港股跟随全球风险/美元走势的工作假说依然有效。
zh.regime_read: 中国A股处于第三季度（滞胀）：增长-0.286（疲弱），通胀0.818（较高，中等置信度）。中国人民银行流动性覆盖中性但宽松冲动正在进行。行业RS显示极端分化——半导体（60日+68%）和科技（+53%）排名第1-2位，而大多数周期股和防御股处于次2百分位（汽车、银行、房地产、必需消费品）。小盘/大盘比率上升（20日+5.3%）且通胀贝塔篮子暴跌（20日-23%），两者均与滞胀象限相矛盾。香港也处于第三季度（滞胀），但叠加全球避险情绪（全球得分-0.692，避险，恐惧指数11），联系汇率弱方接近7.84，VHSI飙升。香港行业RS显示金融/交易所涨幅过大（百分位99-100），而汽车/游戏/原材料深度超卖。美国背景是金发姑娘，流动性收缩，限制性实际利率（2.18%）和强势美元，给新兴市场和香港带来逆风。
zh.rotation_check: 工作假说成立：按照均值回归假说，A股RS领先股（半导体/科技）似乎涨幅过大，深度回调标的（汽车、银行、必需消费品）是更有可能反转的候选。香港与内地显著分化——互联网/科技疲弱，而A股科技强势——反映全球避险和美元走强，完全符合假说预测。雷达背离（新能源汽车、有色金属）支持这一观点：如果增长企稳，被打击的周期股可能追赶，与均值回归和国内政策再通胀一致。
conflicts: 滞胀象限与科技/半导体领先：历史上增长/科技在滞胀中表现落后，而非领先。RS极端值可能表明AI驱动的脱节。
通胀贝塔篮子20日-23%对比高通胀得分（0.818）：市场正在定价通缩或通胀放缓担忧，挑战滞胀分类。
尽管多次降准/降息，中国人民银行立场中性：走廊分类器尚未翻转，因此宽松已被定价但未确认——流动性机制冲突。
香港金融股延续（百分位99.6）在恐惧/避险环境中——通常防御性轮动会利好公用事业/电信，而非顺周期金融股。
美国金发姑娘象限与流动性收缩及美元对新兴市场的逆风并存：美国宏观温和，但美元强势通过限制性传导影响中国/香港。
transmission: 美国实际收益率→美元走强→新兴市场资金外流→港汇弱方（7.8396）→香港股权风险溢价扩大，强化避险情绪。
中国央行利率走廊调整（若中性→确认宽松）→国内流动性注入→利率敏感板块（券商、地产）重新定价→A股广度从极度超卖水平修复。
即将公布的6月30日国家统计局PMI——若>50，周期复苏链（金属、新能源车）强化；若<50，滞胀加深，避险持续，任何反转交易延迟。
香港恒指波幅指数从恐惧区间（波段11）正常化，可能触发最超卖港股板块（汽车-23% 60日、博彩-12%）的剧烈反转。
watch_items: LPR利率调整（6月22日）——任何超过近期10个基点的降息幅度，或前瞻指引转向确认宽松立场。
国家统计局PMI（6月30日）——制造业读数及方向；不及预期将坐实滞胀并延长避险情绪。
人民币（6.79）突破6.80以及港元（7.8396）触及7.85弱方兑换保证——可能触发香港金管局干预/流动性紧缩。
半导体/科技动能衰竭——20日均线跌破或高量反转日作为触发因素，引发均值回归资金流入落后板块。
新能源汽车/材料板块的另类数据积累转化为正向价格RS——早期周期股确认再通胀论调。
